evidence.quote: We shipped the async decision widget.

observations.why: Declarative claim of delivery asserts control over the facts of what was accomplished; no influence attempt on an audience is present.

evidence.quote: Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter.

observations.why: Supplying a measured metric with a superlative frames the facts themselves as the basis of authority; no tactic directed at a listener.

evidence.quote: The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

observations.why: Framing a specific integration as the decisive causal factor controls the interpretive narrative around the facts; no influence attempt on an audience.
